toml:
# LEO-PNT vertical: autonomous vehicles, an urban canyon with a LEO layer.
#
# A car drives east through Munich. On the open road every satellite above 10 deg is
# usable; in the urban canyon the buildings hide everything below 35 deg. Each phase runs
# a `leo-pvt` joint fix (GPS, Galileo and a generic low Earth orbit (LEO) layer of 240
# satellites at 1080 km, 53 deg, with a 0.25 m signal-in-space range error), comparing the
# GNSS-only error with the fused GNSS + LEO error against a 1.5 m lane-level threshold,
# and a `leo-pass` run of one LEO pass seen from the moving car (its geometry is what the
# campaign exports).
#
# In the canyon GPS and Galileo keep 8 satellites above 35 deg and their geometry turns
# poor; the LEO layer adds 4 to 5 more and cuts the mean error from about 5.8 m to about
# 2.1 m, but a single elevation cut-off still leaves the fused error above the lane-level
# threshold at about half the canyon epochs, where the alarm is raised.
#
# MODELLED: a building mask as a single elevation cut-off (no multipath, no
# non-line-of-sight signals); representative LEO signal and range error. The
# `automotive-urban-canyon` scenario covers the inertial side of the same drive.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Autonomous vehicle in an urban canyon with a LEO layer"
seed = 20260929

[timeline]
step_s = 10.0

[[phases]]
name = "open-road"
duration_s = 600.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "gnss_error_m", unit = "m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_gnss_m" },
  { channel = "position_error_m", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].error_fused_m" },
  { channel = "gnss_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_gnss" },
  { channel = "leo_in_view", unit = "count", t = "joint.epochs[].t_s", y = "joint.epochs[].n_leo" },
]
alarms = [{ channel = "position_error_m", compare = "above", threshold = 1.5 }]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pvt"
mode = "joint"
seed = 3
duration_s = 600.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
lat_deg = 48.137
lon_deg = 11.575
height_m = 520.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [35.0, 45.0]
sisre_m = 0.6
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [35.0, 45.0]
sisre_m = 0.3
isb_ns = 12.0
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system]]
name = "Generic LEO"
role = "leo"
carrier_hz = 1191.795e6
chip_rate_hz = 10.23e6
cn0_dbhz = [45.0, 58.0]
sisre_m = 0.25
isb_ns = 25.0
mask_deg = 10.0
[[phases.runs.scenario.system.shell]]
total = 240
planes = 12
phasing = 1
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0

[[phases.runs]]
series = [
  { channel = "leo_pass_elevation_deg", unit = "deg", t = "satellites[0].series[].t_s", y = "satellites[0].series[].elevation_deg" },
]
[phases.runs.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 600.0
step_s = 10.0
[phases.runs.scenario.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 48.137
lon_deg = 11.575
height_m = 520.0
speed_m_s = 14.0
heading_deg = 90.0
mask_deg = 10.0
antenna = "patch"
[[phases.runs.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["L"]
max_elevation_deg = 75.0
tca_s = 300.0
altitude_km = 1080.0
inclination_deg = 53.0
[phases.runs.scenario.gnss]
constellation = "galileo"
band = "E1"

[[phases]]
name = "urban-canyon"
duration_s = 900.0

[[phases.runs]]
